<a id="button"></a>

## Button

Filled, tonal, outlined, text and elevated buttons with shape morphing and toggle mode.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add button`
- Group: Actions
- Files: `components/button.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `ripple`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `class-variance-authority`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/button

Buttons start actions. Pick the variant by emphasis: filled for the primary action on a screen, tonal for secondary actions, outlined and text for lower emphasis, elevated when the button sits on a busy background. Corners spring toward square while pressed; as toggles, they swap between round and square.

### Usage

```tsx
import { Button, ToggleButton } from "@/components/expressive/button";

export function Actions() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      <Button>Save</Button>
      <Button variant="outlined" icon={<DownloadIcon />}>Export</Button>
      <ToggleButton variant="tonal" defaultPressed>Bold</ToggleButton>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Props

**Button**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"filled" \| "tonal" \| "outlined" \| "text" \| "elevated"` | `"filled"` | Visual emphasis. |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | `"sm"` | Height from 32px (xs) to 136px (xl). Type and icon size scale with it. |
| `shape` | `"round" \| "square"` | `"round"` | Resting corner shape. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon, sized automatically. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |
| `render` | `ReactElement` |  | Render as another element, e.g. `<a href>` (set `nativeButton={false}`). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes, merged with tailwind-merge. |

**ToggleButton**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pressed / defaultPressed` | `boolean` |  | Selected state (controlled / uncontrolled). |
| `onPressedChange` | `(pressed: boolean) => void` |  | Called when the selection changes. |
| `…` |  |  | Accepts every Button prop above. |

### Accessibility

- Renders a native `<button>`; Enter and Space activate it.
- ToggleButton sets `aria-pressed`, so screen readers announce it as a toggle.
- Focus ring only appears for keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`).
- Disabled buttons keep their label legible at the disabled-content opacity.

### Notes

- Round buttons use `rounded-pill` (half the control height) so the press morph stays smooth. If you override the height, also set `--ex-control-height`.

<a id="icon-button"></a>

## Icon button

Icon buttons in four styles and three widths, with toggle mode.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add icon-button`
- Group: Actions
- Files: `components/icon-button.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `ripple`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `class-variance-authority`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/icon-button

Icon buttons perform compact actions where an icon is enough: toolbars, app bars, cards. Choose from four styles and three widths; use the toggle version for on/off actions like favorite.

### Usage

```tsx
import { IconButton, ToggleIconButton } from "@/components/expressive/icon-button";

<IconButton aria-label="Search">
  <SearchIcon />
</IconButton>

<ToggleIconButton aria-label="Favorite" variant="filled">
  <HeartIcon />
</ToggleIconButton>
```

### Props

**IconButton**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Required (or `aria-labelledby`): there is no visible text. Enforced by the types. |
| `variant` | `"standard" \| "filled" \| "tonal" \| "outlined"` | `"standard"` | Visual emphasis. |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | `"sm"` | Container height, 32–136px. |
| `width` | `"narrow" \| "default" \| "wide"` | `"default"` | Container width relative to its height. |
| `shape` | `"round" \| "square"` | `"round"` | Resting corner shape. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes, merged with tailwind-merge. |

**ToggleIconButton**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pressed / defaultPressed` | `boolean` |  | Selected state. |
| `onPressedChange` | `(pressed: boolean) => void` |  | Called when the selection changes. |

### Accessibility

- The accessible name is required at the type level, so icon-only buttons can't ship unlabelled.
- Pair with a Tooltip to show the name visually on hover and focus.
- Toggle icon buttons expose `aria-pressed`.

<a id="button-group"></a>

## Button group

Standard button groups whose buttons react to each other, and connected (segmented) toggle groups.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add button-group`
- Group: Actions
- Files: `components/button-group.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `ripple`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `class-variance-authority`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/button-group

Button groups are new in M3 Expressive. A standard group spaces related buttons and makes them respond to each other: the pressed button widens while its neighbours make room. A connected group replaces the segmented button: toggle buttons joined by a 2px gap, with pill ends, and the selected one morphs into a full pill.

### Usage

```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/expressive/button";
import { ButtonGroup, ConnectedButton, ConnectedButtonGroup } from "@/components/expressive/button-group";

<ButtonGroup aria-label="Playback">
  <Button variant="tonal">Previous</Button>
  <Button>Play</Button>
  <Button variant="tonal">Next</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

<ConnectedButtonGroup aria-label="Calendar view" defaultValue={["week"]}>
  <ConnectedButton value="day">Day</ConnectedButton>
  <ConnectedButton value="week">Week</ConnectedButton>
  <ConnectedButton value="month">Month</ConnectedButton>
</ConnectedButtonGroup>
```

### Props

**ButtonGroup**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | `"sm"` | Match the buttons' size. Sets the gap and how far a press widens a button. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Name for the group. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes, merged with tailwind-merge. |

**ConnectedButtonGroup**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value / defaultValue` | `string[]` |  | Values of the selected buttons (controlled / uncontrolled). |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string[]) => void` |  | Called when the selection changes. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow more than one selected button. |
| `deselectable` | `boolean` | `false` | Let a single-select group end up with nothing selected. |
| `variant` | `"filled" \| "tonal" \| "outlined"` | `"filled"` | Colors for the unselected and selected states. |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | `"sm"` | Height from 32px to 136px; corners scale with it. |
| `fill` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch to the container, sharing the width equally. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

**ConnectedButton**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` |  | Identifies the button in the group's value. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon. Icon-only buttons need an `aria-label`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables this button. |

### Accessibility

- Both groups render `role="group"`; give them an `aria-label`.
- Connected buttons are toggle buttons with `aria-pressed`, and arrow keys move focus between them.
- A single-select group keeps one button selected, as M3 does, unless you pass `deselectable`.

### Notes

- The press response in a standard group works by padding (Buttons) or width (IconButtons); keep the group's `size` in step with the buttons inside.

<a id="split-button"></a>

## Split button

A main action joined to a menu button that morphs into a circle while its menu is open.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add split-button`
- Group: Actions
- Files: `components/split-button.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `ripple`, `menu`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `class-variance-authority`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/split-button

A split button pairs a main action with a menu of related ones, like Send with Schedule send. The halves share square inner corners; while the menu is open the trailing half morphs into a circle and its chevron flips.

### Usage

```tsx
import { SplitButton } from "@/components/expressive/split-button";
import { MenuItem } from "@/components/expressive/menu";

<SplitButton
  onClick={send}
  menuLabel="More send options"
  menu={
    <>
      <MenuItem onClick={schedule}>Schedule send</MenuItem>
      <MenuItem onClick={saveDraft}>Save draft</MenuItem>
    </>
  }
>
  Send
</SplitButton>
```

### Props

**SplitButton**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `menu` | `ReactNode` |  | The menu's items, e.g. a few `<MenuItem>`s. |
| `menuLabel` | `string` | `"More options"` | Accessible name for the trailing button. |
| `variant` | `"filled" \| "tonal" \| "outlined" \| "elevated"` | `"filled"` | Visual emphasis. |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | `"sm"` | Height from 32px to 136px. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon on the main action. |
| `open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange` | `boolean / (open) => void` |  | Control the menu. |
| `menuProps` | `MenuContentProps` |  | Passed to the menu popup, e.g. `{ color: "vibrant" }`. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes, merged with tailwind-merge. |

### Accessibility

- Two real buttons in a `role="group"`: the main action, and a menu button with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`.
- The menu supports arrow keys, typeahead and Escape, and returns focus to the trailing button when it closes.

<a id="fab"></a>

## FAB

Floating action buttons in three sizes, plus the extended FAB.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add fab`
- Group: Actions
- Files: `components/fab.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `ripple`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `class-variance-authority`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/fab

A floating action button holds the single most important action on a screen. It comes in three sizes; give it a `label` to make an extended FAB when the icon alone isn't clear enough.

### Usage

```tsx
import { Fab } from "@/components/expressive/fab";

<Fab icon={<EditIcon />} aria-label="Compose" />
<Fab icon={<EditIcon />} label="Compose" size="medium" color="tertiary-container" />
```

### Props

**Fab**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | The icon. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label. Makes it an extended FAB. Without it, `aria-label` is required. |
| `size` | `"default" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"default"` | 56, 80 or 96px. |
| `color` | `"primary-container" \| "secondary-container" \| "tertiary-container" \| "primary" \| "secondary" \| "tertiary" \| "surface"` | `"primary-container"` | Container color role. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes, merged with tailwind-merge. |

### Accessibility

- Renders a native button with a required accessible name.
- Use one FAB per screen so its action is unambiguous.

<a id="fab-menu"></a>

## FAB menu

A FAB that opens related actions, morphing into a close button as the items spring up.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add fab-menu`
- Group: Actions
- Files: `components/fab-menu.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `fab`, `ripple`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/fab-menu

The FAB menu opens two to six related actions from a floating action button. On open the FAB morphs into a smaller, filled close button and the actions spring up above it one after another, each a pill in the FAB's container color.

### Usage

```tsx
import { FabMenu, FabMenuItem } from "@/components/expressive/fab-menu";

<FabMenu icon={<AddIcon />} aria-label="Create">
  <FabMenuItem icon={<DocumentIcon />} onClick={newDocument}>Document</FabMenuItem>
  <FabMenuItem icon={<FolderIcon />} onClick={newFolder}>Folder</FabMenuItem>
</FabMenu>
```

### Props

**FabMenu**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | The FAB's icon while closed; it turns into a close icon when open. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Required: names the FAB, e.g. "Create". |
| `color` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "tertiary"` | `"primary"` | Color family for the FAB and the items. |
| `size` | `"default" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"default"` | Size of the closed FAB. Open, it's the 56px close button. |
| `open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange` | `boolean / (open) => void` |  | Control the menu. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

**FabMenuItem**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon. |
| `onClick` | `(event) => void` |  | Runs the action; the menu then closes. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables this action. |

### Accessibility

- The FAB is a menu button (`aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded`) and the actions are menu items.
- Arrow keys move between actions, typeahead jumps to one, and Escape closes the menu and refocuses the FAB.
- Under reduced motion the items appear without the staggered spring.

<a id="chip"></a>

## Chips

Assist, suggestion, filter and input chips.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add chip`
- Group: Actions
- Files: `components/chip.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `ripple`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/chip

Chips are compact elements for actions, filters, suggestions and entities. Assist chips trigger a related action, suggestion chips offer generated replies, filter chips toggle a filter on or off, and input chips represent something the user entered (with a remove button).

### Usage

```tsx
import { AssistChip, FilterChip, InputChip, SuggestionChip } from "@/components/expressive/chip";

<AssistChip icon={<CalendarIcon />}>Add to calendar</AssistChip>
<SuggestionChip>Sounds good</SuggestionChip>
<FilterChip defaultPressed>Vegetarian</FilterChip>
<InputChip onRemove={() => remove(id)}>Ada Lovelace</InputChip>
```

### Props

**AssistChip / SuggestionChip**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon. |
| `appearance` | `"outlined" \| "elevated"` | `"outlined"` | Use elevated on images or busy backgrounds. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

**FilterChip**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pressed / defaultPressed` | `boolean` |  | Whether the filter is applied. |
| `onPressedChange` | `(pressed: boolean) => void` |  | Called when toggled. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Optional leading icon, replaced by the check mark when selected. |

**InputChip**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` |  | Shows a remove button. Also fires on Backspace/Delete when it's focused. |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | `"Remove {label}"` | Accessible name of the remove button. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Avatar or icon. |
| `selected` | `boolean` |  | Selected appearance. |

### Accessibility

- Assist, suggestion and filter chips are native buttons; filter chips expose `aria-pressed`.
- The input chip's remove button has its own accessible name, e.g. “Remove Ada Lovelace”.

<a id="calendar"></a>

## Calendar

Month grid for single, multiple or range selection, on react-day-picker.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add calendar`
- Group: Selection & input
- Files: `components/calendar.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `react-day-picker`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/calendar

The calendar is a month grid for choosing a date, several dates or a range, in the M3 date picker style: circular days, the selection in primary, today outlined, and ranges joined by a tonal band. It's built on react-day-picker, which supplies the date logic, keyboard grid, localization and time zones, so every react-day-picker prop works.

### Usage

```tsx
import { Calendar } from "@/components/expressive/calendar";

const [date, setDate] = useState<Date>();
<Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />

<Calendar
  mode="range"
  selected={range}
  onSelect={setRange}
  numberOfMonths={2}
  disabled={{ before: new Date() }}
  captionLayout="dropdown"
/>
```

### Props

**Calendar**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `"single" \| "multiple" \| "range"` |  | Selection mode. |
| `selected / onSelect` | `Date \| Date[] \| DateRange` |  | The selection and its setter, typed by `mode`. |
| `disabled` | `Matcher \| Matcher[]` |  | Days that can't be picked: dates, ranges, `{ before }`, `{ dayOfWeek }`, functions. |
| `defaultMonth / month` | `Date` |  | The month shown first (or controlled). |
| `numberOfMonths` | `number` | `1` | Months side by side. |
| `captionLayout` | `"label" \| "dropdown" \| …` | `"label"` | Month and year dropdowns in the caption. |
| `locale / weekStartsOn / timeZone` |  |  | Localization, from react-day-picker. |
| `showOutsideDays` | `boolean` | `true` | Show days from the neighbouring months. |
| `classNames` | `Partial<ClassNames>` |  | Override any part's classes. |

### Accessibility

- A labelled grid: arrow keys move by day and week, Home/End to the week's ends, Page Up/Down by month (with Shift, by year).
- Days are buttons announced with the full date; selected and disabled states are exposed.
- Month names, weekdays and the first day of the week follow `locale`.

### Notes

- Adds `react-day-picker` (and `date-fns`) to your dependencies. Don't import react-day-picker's stylesheet: the classes here replace it.

<a id="checkbox"></a>

## Checkbox

Checkbox with a springy check mark, indeterminate and error states.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add checkbox`
- Group: Selection & input
- Files: `components/checkbox.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/checkbox

Checkboxes let people select one or more options from a list, or turn a single setting on or off when a switch would be too strong. Checking pops the box, softens its corners and draws the check in.

### Usage

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/expressive/checkbox";

<label className="flex items-center gap-1">
  <Checkbox defaultChecked /> Email me about updates
</label>

<Checkbox checked={allSelected} indeterminate={someSelected} onCheckedChange={selectAll} />
```

### Props

**Checkbox**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked / defaultChecked` | `boolean` |  | Checked state (controlled / uncontrolled). |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  | Called when toggled. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a dash for a partially selected group. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Prevents interaction. |
| `name / value` | `string` |  | Submitted with forms. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

### Accessibility

- Exposes `role="checkbox"` and `aria-checked` (including `mixed` when indeterminate).
- Space toggles it. Wrap it in a `<label>` so the text is its accessible name and a larger click target.
- Inside an invalid Base UI Field, it switches to the error color.

<a id="date-picker"></a>

## Date picker

Docked date and date-range pickers: a field that opens a calendar.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add date-picker`
- Group: Selection & input
- Files: `components/date-picker.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `calendar`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `react-day-picker`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/date-picker

Date pickers are fields that open a calendar, M3's "docked" picker: `DatePicker` for one date, `DateRangePicker` for a start and end. They close when the choice is complete, return focus to the field, and submit with forms through a hidden input.

### Usage

```tsx
import { DatePicker, DateRangePicker } from "@/components/expressive/date-picker";

<DatePicker label="Departure" name="departure" value={date ?? null} onValueChange={setDate} />

<DateRangePicker
  label="Stay"
  name="stay"
  calendarProps={{ disabled: { before: new Date() }, numberOfMonths: 2 }}
/>
```

### Props

**DatePicker**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required visible label. |
| `value / defaultValue` | `Date \| null` |  | The date (controlled / uncontrolled). `null` means nothing picked. |
| `onValueChange` | `(date: Date \| undefined) => void` |  | Called when a date is picked. |
| `variant` | `"filled" \| "outlined"` | `"filled"` | Field style, matching TextField. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Submits the date as `YYYY-MM-DD` with forms. |
| `format` | `(date: Date) => string` |  | Field text. Defaults to the locale's medium date ("Oct 20, 2026"). |
| `locale` | `string` |  | Locale for the field text. |
| `calendarProps` | `CalendarProps` |  | Passed to the calendar: `disabled`, `startMonth`, `captionLayout`, `locale`… |
| `supportingText / errorText / invalid` |  |  | Helper and error text, as on TextField. |
| `open / onOpenChange` | `boolean` |  | Control the popover. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

**DateRangePicker**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value / defaultValue` | `DateRange \| null` |  | `{ from, to }`. |
| `onValueChange` | `(range) => void` |  | Called as each end is picked. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Submits `YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD` with forms. |
| `…` |  |  | Every other DatePicker prop. |

### Accessibility

- The field is a button named by its label and current value, with the supporting or error text as its description.
- The calendar takes focus on the selected day (or today); Escape closes it and returns focus to the field.
- The calendar's keyboard grid is described on the Calendar page.

### Notes

- Typing a date isn't supported yet; for keyboard-heavy forms, a `TextField` with `type="date"` is the fallback.

<a id="menu"></a>

## Menu

Menus with icons, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items, groups and submenus.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add menu`
- Group: Selection & input
- Files: `components/menu.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/menu

Menus show a list of choices on a temporary surface. Expressive menus have a rounded container and items that morph into a rounder, tinted shape when selected. Use checkbox and radio items for settings, groups with labels to organise long menus, and submenus for nested choices.

### Usage

```tsx
import {
  Menu,
  MenuContent,
  MenuItem,
  MenuSeparator,
  MenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/expressive/menu";

<Menu>
  <MenuTrigger render={<Button variant="tonal" />}>Options</MenuTrigger>
  <MenuContent>
    <MenuItem icon={<EditIcon />} trailing="⌘E">Rename</MenuItem>
    <MenuItem icon={<CopyIcon />}>Duplicate</MenuItem>
    <MenuSeparator />
    <MenuItem icon={<DeleteIcon />}>Delete</MenuItem>
  </MenuContent>
</Menu>
```

### Props

**MenuContent**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `"standard" \| "vibrant"` | `"standard"` | Surface or tertiary-container colors. Submenus inherit it. |
| `side / align` | `string` | `"bottom" / "center"` | Placement against the trigger. |
| `sideOffset` | `number` | `4` | Gap from the trigger, in px. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes, merged with tailwind-merge. |

**MenuItem**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon. |
| `trailing` | `ReactNode` |  | A keyboard shortcut or trailing icon. |
| `supportingText` | `ReactNode` |  | A second line under the label. |
| `onClick` | `(event) => void` |  | Runs the action; the menu then closes. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables the item. |

**MenuCheckboxItem**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked / defaultChecked / onCheckedChange` | `boolean` |  | On/off state; a check shows while on. |

**MenuRadioGroup**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value / defaultValue / onValueChange` | `string` |  | The selected `MenuRadioItem`'s value. |

**Menu**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange` | `boolean` |  | Control the menu. |
| `modal` | `boolean` | `true` | Lock page scroll and outside interaction while open. |

### Accessibility

- Built on Base UI's menu: `role="menu"` with `menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox` and `menuitemradio` items.
- Arrow keys move the highlight, typeahead jumps to an item, and Escape closes the menu and refocuses the trigger.
- Right arrow opens a submenu, left arrow closes it.

<a id="radio-group"></a>

## Radio group

Radio buttons with arrow-key navigation.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add radio-group`
- Group: Selection & input
- Files: `components/radio-group.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/radio-group

Radio buttons let people pick exactly one option from a short list. Show all options when there are few; use a menu or select for long lists.

### Usage

```tsx
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from "@/components/expressive/radio-group";

<RadioGroup aria-labelledby="shipping" defaultValue="standard">
  <label><Radio value="standard" /> Standard</label>
  <label><Radio value="express" /> Express</label>
</RadioGroup>
```

### Props

**RadioGroup**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value / defaultValue` | `unknown` |  | The selected value. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value) => void` |  | Called when the selection changes. |
| `aria-labelledby / aria-label` | `string` |  | Names the group. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables every option. |

**Radio**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `unknown` |  | Value this option represents. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables this option. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

### Accessibility

- Arrow keys move the selection; Tab moves into and out of the group as one stop.
- Give the group a name with `aria-labelledby` pointing at a visible heading.

<a id="select"></a>

## Select

Filled and outlined dropdown fields with a floating label and a Material menu.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add select`
- Group: Selection & input
- Files: `components/select.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/select

Select (M3's exposed dropdown menu) is a field that opens a menu of options. It matches the text field, filled or outlined with a floating label, and its menu matches Expressive's menus. Use it for choosing one option from a list too long for radio buttons.

### Usage

```tsx
import { Select } from "@/components/expressive/select";

<Select
  label="Country"
  name="country"
  value={country}
  onValueChange={setCountry}
  items={[
    { value: "np", label: "Nepal" },
    { value: "pt", label: "Portugal" },
  ]}
/>
```

### Props

**Select**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required visible label. |
| `items` | `{ value, label, disabled? }[]` |  | The options; lets the field show the chosen label. |
| `value / defaultValue` | `unknown` |  | The chosen value (controlled / uncontrolled). |
| `onValueChange` | `(value) => void` |  | Called when an option is chosen. |
| `variant` | `"filled" \| "outlined"` | `"filled"` | Field style. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Choose several options. |
| `name / required` |  |  | Form submission, through Base UI. |
| `supportingText / errorText / invalid` |  |  | Helper and error text, as on TextField. |
| `leadingIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon in the field. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Custom options: `SelectItem`, `SelectGroup`, `SelectGroupLabel`, `SelectSeparator`. Keep `items` too, for the field text. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

**SelectItem**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `unknown` |  | The option's value. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables the option. |

### Accessibility

- Base UI's select: a combobox trigger named by the label, a listbox of options, typeahead, and arrow-key selection.
- The chosen option shows a check, not only a color.
- Helper and error text are wired to the field through Base UI's Field.

<a id="slider"></a>

## Slider

Expressive slider with a bar handle; single value or range.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add slider`
- Group: Selection & input
- Files: `components/slider.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/slider

Sliders pick a value or range from a continuous scale. The M3 Expressive slider has a thick track and a bar-shaped handle that narrows while you drag it.

### Usage

```tsx
import { Slider } from "@/components/expressive/slider";

<Slider defaultValue={40} thumbLabels={["Volume"]} />
<Slider defaultValue={[20, 80]} thumbLabels={["Minimum price", "Maximum price"]} />
```

### Props

**Slider**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value / defaultValue` | `number \| number[]` |  | One number for a single thumb, an array for a range. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value) => void` |  | Called while dragging. |
| `min / max / step` | `number` | `0 / 100 / 1` | Range and granularity. |
| `thumbLabels` | `string[]` |  | Accessible names for each thumb. |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Layout direction. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Prevents interaction. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

### Accessibility

- Each thumb is a `role="slider"` input with `aria-valuenow`, `min` and `max`.
- Arrow keys step by `step`; Page Up/Down and Home/End jump.
- Name every thumb with `thumbLabels` (or `aria-labelledby` on the slider).

### Notes

- The gap around the handle is a ring in `--ex-slider-gap-color` (default `surface`). Set it to the background color when the slider sits on another surface.

<a id="switch"></a>

## Switch

M3 switch with growing handle and optional icons.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add switch`
- Group: Selection & input
- Files: `components/switch.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/switch

Switches turn a single setting on or off immediately, like Wi-Fi. Use a checkbox instead when the change only applies after saving a form.

### Usage

```tsx
import { Switch } from "@/components/expressive/switch";

<label className="flex items-center gap-4">
  <Switch defaultChecked /> Wi-Fi
</label>

<Switch icons checked={dark} onCheckedChange={setDark} />
```

### Props

**Switch**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked / defaultChecked` | `boolean` |  | On state. |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  | Called when toggled. |
| `icons` | `boolean` | `false` | Show check and close icons in the handle. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Prevents interaction. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

### Accessibility

- Exposes `role="switch"` with `aria-checked`; Space toggles it.
- Label it with a wrapping `<label>` or `aria-label`.

<a id="text-field"></a>

## Text field

Filled and outlined text fields with floating labels, icons, supporting and error text.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add text-field`
- Group: Selection & input
- Files: `components/text-field.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/text-field

Text fields let people enter and edit text. Filled fields carry more visual emphasis, outlined fields less; pick one style and use it throughout a form. The label floats up when the field is focused or filled.

### Usage

```tsx
import { TextField } from "@/components/expressive/text-field";

<TextField label="Email" type="email" supportingText="We'll never share it" />
<TextField label="Search" variant="outlined" leadingIcon={<SearchIcon />} />
<TextField label="Name" invalid errorText="Enter your name" />
```

### Props

**TextField**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Required visible label, wired to the input. |
| `variant` | `"filled" \| "outlined"` | `"filled"` | Container style. |
| `supportingText` | `ReactNode` |  | Helper text below the field, announced as its description. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Error state. |
| `errorText` | `ReactNode` |  | Replaces the supporting text while invalid. |
| `leadingIcon / trailingIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icons inside the container. |
| `labelBackground` | `string` | `surface` | Outlined only: the color behind the field, used for the label's cut-out. |
| `…` | `input props` |  | Everything else (`value`, `onChange`, `type`, `name`…) goes to the input. |

### Accessibility

- Built on Base UI Field: the label, description and error are linked to the input automatically.
- Invalid fields set `aria-invalid` and announce the error text as the description.
- Placeholders only appear on focus, so the label is never replaced by placeholder text.

<a id="breadcrumb"></a>

## Breadcrumb

Hierarchy trail of links with chevron separators and the current page.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add breadcrumb`
- Group: Navigation
- Files: `components/breadcrumb.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/breadcrumb

Breadcrumbs show where the current page sits in a hierarchy and link back up it. Use them for deep structures like docs, file browsers and catalogs, not as primary navigation.

### Usage

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem } from "@/components/expressive/breadcrumb";

<Breadcrumb>
  <BreadcrumbItem render={<Link href="/" />} icon={<HomeIcon />}>Home</BreadcrumbItem>
  <BreadcrumbItem render={<Link href="/docs" />}>Docs</BreadcrumbItem>
  <BreadcrumbItem current>Button</BreadcrumbItem>
</Breadcrumb>
```

### Props

**Breadcrumb**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `"Breadcrumb"` | Name of the navigation landmark. |

**BreadcrumbItem**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string` |  | Link target (or use `render`). |
| `render` | `ReactElement` | `<a>` | Your router's link, e.g. `<Link href />`. |
| `current` | `boolean` |  | The current page: plain text with `aria-current="page"`. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading icon. |

### Accessibility

- A `<nav>` landmark around an ordered list, so screen readers announce the trail and its length.
- Separators are drawn and hidden from assistive tech; they flip in right-to-left layouts.

<a id="navigation-bar"></a>

## Navigation bar

Bottom navigation bar with a springy active indicator and badges.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add navigation-bar`
- Group: Navigation
- Files: `components/navigation-bar.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/navigation-bar

The navigation bar sits at the bottom of compact screens and switches between three to five top-level destinations. The active indicator springs open from the icon's center.

### Usage

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { NavigationBar, NavigationBarItem } from "@/components/expressive/navigation-bar";

<NavigationBar>
  <NavigationBarItem render={<Link href="/" />} icon={<HomeIcon />} label="Home" active />
  <NavigationBarItem render={<Link href="/inbox" />} icon={<InboxIcon />} label="Inbox" badge={3} />
</NavigationBar>
```

### Props

**NavigationBar**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `"Main"` | Name of the navigation landmark. |

**NavigationBarItem**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` |  | Destination icon. |
| `activeIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Shown instead of `icon` when active (often the filled version). |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label. |
| `active` | `boolean` |  | Marks the current destination (`aria-current="page"`). |
| `badge` | `boolean \| number \| string` |  | `true` for a dot, or a count. |
| `render` | `ReactElement` | `<a>` | Your router's link, e.g. `<Link href />`. |

### Accessibility

- Renders a `<nav>` landmark of links.
- The active item has `aria-current="page"`.

<a id="navigation-drawer"></a>

## Navigation drawer

Standard and modal navigation drawers with section headlines and a springy active indicator.

- Install: `npx @grenishrai/expressive add navigation-drawer`
- Group: Navigation
- Files: `components/navigation-drawer.tsx`
- Expressive dependencies: `utils`, `motion`, `styles`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`
- Docs: https://expressive.grenishrai.pro/docs/components/navigation-drawer

Navigation drawers list destinations in a column, for apps with many top-level places or labels. Use `NavigationDrawer` in the layout on large screens, and `ModalNavigationDrawer` from a menu button on smaller ones. On medium screens, the expanded navigation rail is often the better fit.

### Usage

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  ModalNavigationDrawer,
  NavigationDrawerHeadline,
  NavigationDrawerItem,
} from "@/components/expressive/navigation-drawer";

<ModalNavigationDrawer open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} trigger={<IconButton aria-label="Menu"><MenuIcon /></IconButton>}>
  <NavigationDrawerHeadline>Mail</NavigationDrawerHeadline>
  <NavigationDrawerItem render={<Link href="/inbox" />} icon={<InboxIcon />} label="Inbox" badge="24" active />
  <NavigationDrawerItem render={<Link href="/sent" />} icon={<SendIcon />} label="Sent" />
</ModalNavigationDrawer>
```

### Props

**NavigationDrawer**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `"Main"` | Name of the navigation landmark. |

**ModalNavigationDrawer**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement` |  | The element that opens it, usually a menu IconButton. |
| `open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange` | `boolean` |  | Control the drawer; close it when a destination is chosen. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `"Main"` | Name for the dialog and its navigation landmark. |
| `motion` | `"expressive" \| "standard" \| "fluid" \| "none"` | `theme default` | Motion scheme for this component's transitions. `none` turns animation off. |

**NavigationDrawerItem**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon / activeIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Destination icon, and an optional filled one for the active state. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label. |
| `badge` | `ReactNode` |  | Trailing text, e.g. an unread count. |
| `active` | `boolean` |  | Marks the current destination (`aria-current="page"`). |
| `render` | `ReactElement` | `<a>` | Your router's link, e.g. `<Link href />`. |

### Accessibility

- Renders a `<nav>` landmark of links; the active one has `aria-current="page"`.
- The modal drawer is a `dialog` that traps focus, closes with Escape, the scrim or a swipe left, and returns focus to its trigger.
- `NavigationDrawerHeadline` renders an `<h2>`; use your own heading if the page needs a different level.

>

</NavigationRail>

**NavigationRail**

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Wide layout with horizontal items. |
| `header` | `ReactNode` |  | Top slot for a menu button and/or FAB. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `"Main"` | Name of the navigation landmark. |

**NavigationRailItem**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
